description: Cleaned ERP customers. Segment and province are standardised. Email and phone are personal data (BR-18).
Cleaned ERP products with the harmonised 5-digit product key (BR-02) and units per case (BR-03).
Cleaned ERP order headers. The ERP is the system of record for promised dates and order status (BR-01).
Cleaned ERP order lines. Lines whose order is missing or rejected are removed (BR-17).
Cleaned WMS shipment headers. The WMS is the system of record for ship and delivery times (BR-01, BR-04).
Cleaned WMS shipment lines, one row per shipment and line number. The latest update wins (BR-05).
Cleaned WMS lots with expiry dates and the inventory snapshot. Lots without an expiry date are non-perishable (BR-14).
Calendar dimension, one row per day, contiguous from the first to the last business date in the data.
Customer dimension. Email and phone are deliberately excluded because they are personal data (BR-18).
Product dimension with units per case, cost, price and perishability.
Warehouse dimension (reference list of the three distribution centres).
One row per order line with cumulative shipped quantity, fill, backorder and over-shipment measures (BR-03, BR-07, BR-10 to BR-12).
One row per order with delivery dates, lead time and the on-time, in-full and OTIF flags (BR-06, BR-08 to BR-10, BR-13).
One row per shipment line with the lot expiry check. Includes shipments of unknown orders because the compliance risk exists anyway (BR-14, BR-17).
One row per lot at the snapshot date with stock, stock value and expiry status (BR-15).
Order KPIs by order month, customer segment and warehouse for closed orders. Numerators and denominators are stored with the ratios so they can be re-aggregated (BR-06 to BR-13).
Shipment lines and cases that left from expired lots, by ship month, warehouse and product category (BR-14).
Stock and expired stock at the snapshot date, by warehouse and product category (BR-15).
Orders whose ERP status contradicts the WMS: every shipment is delivered and the last delivery is at least 7 days old, yet the ERP has not closed the order (BR-16).
